title: Headless The Power of the Atom (MS11, TTW 3.4): from Lucas Simms' offer to Megaton's bomb disarmed (stage 210)

actions.text: Given: the player is out of Vault 101 in the Capital Wasteland, Following in His Footsteps (MQ01) at its first stage (10) [observed], with Explosives 25 (given: MS11BombScript asks for 25 to touch the bomb and 25 to disarm it). MS11 is Start Game Enabled [observed]; the player has come into Megaton. The winning MS11 record is TaleOfTwoWastelands.esm's, over Broken Steel's [observed].

Path (Megaton saved): the player goes down to the bomb in the crater (within 800 units: BombKnowledge); Sheriff Lucas Simms' first greeting and the talk of the bomb (MS11LucasBomb, MS11LucasBomb1a, MS11LucasBomb2a) to the offer to disarm it (MS11BombChoiceDisarmChoiceGood: stage 10); the bomb's message, second button, disarms it (MS11BombScript: Disarm 2, stage 30, Simms told to greet the player); Simms' greeting for the disarmed bomb pays and gives the house (stage 210, Complete; quest stops). The other side, Mister Burke's fusion pulse charge and the detonator at Tenpenny Tower (15, 40, 50, 60, 200), is not played. [observed: MS11 stage, INFO and object scripts on the TTW load order]
Stand-in for the walk down into the crater: near the bomb its script sets BombKnowledge.
The bomb's message (MS11BombMessage): its second button disarms it with Explosives 25 (Disarm 2, stage 30).
Simms' forcegreet (his dialogue package) is the player's talk with him here; his greeting for the disarmed bomb sets 210.
